description: This Java class 'ColorScaler' provides utility methods for generating interpolated colors based on a scaling factor. It retrieves settings, converts RGB to HSB, and computes a scaled color between minimum and maximum colors.

classes.name: ColorScaler
classes.description: Final utility class for color scaling operations

methods.name: getScaledColor
methods.description: Returns a color scaled between min and max colors based on a scale factor

methods.name: rgbToHsb
methods.description: Converts an RGB color to its HSB (Hue, Saturation, Brightness) components
